paragraphs: These retained results predate the current September 25–28 studies. Each study keeps its own fitted model, dataset, interface, trial denominator and evidence class. Repeated analyzer draws, timing repeats, paired contexts and duplicated reports are not independent model fits.

L is an empirical attack-success lower bound and U a ceiling within the stated experiment. Descriptive screens and numerical floors cannot authorize release. All 17 public scaling cells retain only the trivial ceiling U = 1. Floors below 0.5 are the source’s raw attack floors; an available equal-prior guessing strategy is at least 0.5.

Controlled CNN/LLM/XGBoost family names are labels for synthetic finite channels. The model-backed compact transformer is a text-classification proxy, not a generative LLM. Model-backed v2 and v3 use different hypotheses; v2 failed its raw-proxy CLEAR-power target, whereas v3 restricts the resolution criterion to oracle margin at least 0.10. No model-backed oracle exceeds the 0.65 policy threshold, so unsafe-side power was not tested there.

sections.title: Public model workloads: datasets, settings and uncertainty
paragraphs: The September 6 scaling runs are single-seed, one-epoch or fixed-round benchmarks, not estimates of variation across model retraining. Frozen completion rosters contain five XGBoost, six vision and six generative-language cells. Numerical binomial endpoints were recomputed; they are not outward-verified formal certificates. Model checkpoint hashes describe discarded in-memory serializations; model weights were not retained for replay.

For the public screens, thresholds are chosen on separate calibration data and audits sample with replacement from calibration-excluded finite pools. Repeated draws may revisit the same record. Reported trial counts are draws, not distinct people or records. Equal-prior membership results are conditional on these pools and do not imply training-process DP, population privacy or pretraining-membership inference.

The L4 hook studies are separate September 2 workloads. The language run uses one pinned WildChat shard and a filtered projection, not the entire multi-million-conversation archive. K2/K3 require candidate-loss scoring; K4 exact roster is a logical disclosure example without measured BA/AUC. Vision perturbation success is conditional on initially correct predictions and is a robustness screen, not a privacy result.

sections.title: September 10 local framework: model and attack comparisons
paragraphs: The retained PASS report validates the workflow over 40 model/dataset routing combinations: 22 supported training cells and 18 deliberately rejected unsupported cells. Every supported release verdict is inconclusive. Across the supported cells, 193 attack invocations completed, 33 were unsupported and none failed. PASS means the test behaved as expected, not that privacy or safety passed.

Models include XGBoost, logistic regression, random forest, MLP, further-tuned MLP, CNN, ridge regression, forest regression, SVM and an ensemble. Breast-cancer, wine, digits and diabetes are sklearn benchmark datasets. Most classifier partitions are 369/200,115/63 and 1168/629 fit/evaluation records respectively; diabetes is 287/155. XGBoost uses a different partition and its attack datasets are smaller than its utility assessment, so its denominators are listed separately in the attack tables.

These attacks are screens. No screen grants clearance; score-based thresholds target an FPR without certifying it, while worst-case membership explicitly reports simultaneous FPR upper and TPR lower endpoints and whether the operating point was attained. Uncertified score attacks must not be interpreted as operating-point evidence. Attribute inference assumes other transformed features and true class; its first feature is illustrative, not a declared sensitive attribute. Model extraction measures functional imitation, not weight recovery.

Numeric/adaptive perturbations may not be semantically valid. Label-poisoning and trigger-backdoor experiments retrain in-memory copies of the candidate; they test hypothetical compromised training and do not establish that the original model is poisoned. Two repetitions of these settings are retained as settings, not as independent source populations.

sections.title: Independent logistic and depth-2 tree synthetic model study
paragraphs: All 168 independent model fits completed: 84 logistic and 84 depth-2 CART, each on a fresh256-example synthetic dataset. Four secret-flip regimes and three randomized-response controls are paired within each model, producing2016 candidate evaluations. These2016 rows are not2016 independently trained models.

The exact finite population has36 grid points. Secret-flip probabilities are 7/16,5/16,1/4 and 1/16; randomized-response controls areρ=0,0.1 and 0.2. The privacy ceiling threshold is 0.65 and utility floor0.75. Each channel state uses20,000 draws; each model/control utility experiment uses20,000 draws shared across regimes. The registered2016 channel and 504 utility families have simultaneous evaluation failure upper below 0.000965.

Results cover a single-label finite attribute-inference release. They exclude model weights, inputs, identities, timing, logs and adaptive query histories. The local hash freeze is not an external preregistration. Six tree models with point-estimate utility violations recur across three contexts; these are not18 independent failures.

sections.title: Unavailable model studies and historical limitations
paragraphs: Configured designs, software tests, synthetic model labels and completed training experiments are kept distinct. No completed diffusion or audio model experiment is established by this inventory. References to published diffusion attacks are external research rather than a project run. OpenML DP-SGD and related configured designs have no retained full study seal here; later field-level randomized-response DP is a different mechanism, not DP-SGD.

The directory named multi-model-validation-20260910 contains only a historical unittest log, not another model-training comparison. Its709 tests finished with 2 failures and 18 skips. Both failures concern finite-channel experiment tests. The later retained local framework PASS report does not erase this earlier failure log.

Legacy public-privacy files lack a completion seal and use a pooled binomial lower bound that is not justified for heterogeneous member/nonmember success probabilities. Their descriptive point results are retained, while their unsupported confidence claim is excluded. The two paths repeat the same four observations.
